research.name: React UseAnimations
research.note: Lottie-based animated icon set for React whose icons play a short state change on click, such as a star filling or a trash lid lifting.
research.license: Custom useAnimations terms: CC BY 4.0 with required attribution to useanimations.com, plus a ban on redistribution or resale of the files

effects: line icons that animate between two states on click (star outline fills solid, trash lid lifts, settings sliders shift)
reverse prop to start an icon in its end state for controlled toggles such as checkbox and radio button
per-icon imports so only the used Lottie animation files are bundled
